messages:
oliver: Heads-up — found plaintext AWS creds embedded in a k8s agent image build log from a canary run in prod-us-west-2. Need immediate containment + coordinated retirement of any ephemeral tokens and affected service role keys. tagging @maya @leon for revocation + @rita for cluster sweep.

maya: on it. i'll start rotating keys and push a patched image without logs. will update here when revoked. :lock:

leon: which namespace/pod exactly? can we list the image digest so CI can block older ones?

oliver: namespace=agent-runner, pod example agent-runner-7f8d9, image digest sha256:abc123... logs were at /build/ci_logs/build_output.log inside the image. not from running container — came from the image build step.

rita: running a quick cluster-wide grep for similar strings across clusters. command i'll run: ```kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.namespace}/{.metadata.name}:{range .spec.containers[*]}{.image} "\n"{end}{end}' | xargs -I {} sh -c "kubectl exec -n ${NS} ${POD} -- cat /build/ci_logs/build_output.log 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'AKIA|aws_secret' || true"``` will post hits.

zoe: creating a temporary IAM deny policy and attaching to the affected role so creds in the wild can't be used while we rotate. also opening a ticket in tracker (SEC-3129).

sec-bot: alert: secret-scan detected string pattern 'AKIA' in image sha256:abc123... — severity: high. ticket SEC-3129 created.

oncall-sre: i'm on pager. coordinating with cloud infra to revoke any active access keys tied to that role; ETA ~15m. please post service account list.

maya: commands i'll run to disable keys (example): ```aws iam list-access-keys --user-name agent-builder && aws iam update-access-key --access-key-id <id> --status Inactive --user-name agent-builder``` then create new key and rotate usage in vault. after keys disabled i'll revoke sessions: ```aws sts revoke-session --access-key-id <id>``` (prod AWS account).

maya: also will rewrap any Vault transit ciphertexts that reference the old iam credentials and bump Vault->KMS wrapping keys. sample vault steps: ```vault write sys/replicate/rewrap ciphertext=@old.ct --wrap-ttl=0 && vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext=@old.ct`"`(note: adapt to our transit path)```

leon: i'll block the offending image in the registry with a policy and trigger pipeline to rebuild images w/ build logs redaction. pushing a guardrail to CI to fail if /build/ci_logs present in final image.

rita: cluster sweep results: found same pattern in one staging cluster image and one dev image (sha256:def456, sha256:ghi789). both flagged and quarantined.

zoe: good catch. i'll add those images to the registry quarantine list and pin production to the new digest once maya confirms rotation. also adding an IAM condition to prevent long-lived access keys for builder roles.

oncall-sre: confirmation: revoked keys for user agent-builder (two keys) at 3987654310. updated the deny policy. continuing to monitor CloudTrail for any suspicious usage.

oliver: thanks. action items for post-containment: 1) postmortem w/ timeline (i'll own) 2) CI change to strip build logs from final images (leon) 3) Vault audit logging enabled for transit keys (i'll request retention bump) 4) org-wide note about ephemeral creds best-practices (zoe). please DM me when tasks done. :thumbsup:

sec-bot: update: cloudtrail alert rule triggered — 2 failed auth attempts from rotated keys, no successful API calls. logged under SEC-3129.

maya: rotation complete, new keys in Vault, image rebuilt and deployed to canary without logs. linking new artifact sha256:zzz111.

leon: CI guardrail landed in pipeline ruleset. new builds will fail if /build/ci_logs exists in final image.

rita: swept clusters again; no other images found.

zoe: updated IAM guardrails and created org note draft for credential hygiene.

oliver: closing coordination channel once we've verified audit logs retained for 90 days. i'll post postmortem in #postmortems tomorrow. great work.

sec-bot: ticket SEC-3129 updated to status: contained -> monitoring.
